## TemplateEngine.\_processScriptBlocks() method

Transforms `<script>` blocks into executable JavaScript expressions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processScriptBlocks(template: string): string;
```

## Parameters

**Returns:**

string

The template with `<script>` blocks converted to executable expressions

## Remarks

This internal method converts `<script>` blocks into self-invoking functions that execute with access to the `data` object via `with(data)`<!-- -->. If the script throws an error or `data` is undefined, an empty string is returned.

\*\*Attributes:\*\* - none

## Example


```typescript
const template = '<script>return name ? `Hello ${name}` : `Hello`;</script>';
const processed = TemplateEngine._processScriptBlocks(template);
// Result: '${(() => { if (!data) return ''; try { with(data) { return name ? `Hello ${name}` : `Hello`; } } catch(e) { return '' } })()}'
```
